name: vivid-smiles-cms
description: Local headless WordPress instance backing the Vivid Smiles Astro site.

scripts.import:blog: node import/build-blog-payload.mjs && wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/vs-import/bin/import-blog.php
scripts.import:pages: node import/build-pages-payload.mjs && wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/vs-import/bin/import-pages.php
scripts.import:all: npm run import:settings && npm run import:gallery && npm run import:reviews && npm run import:blog && npm run import:pages && npm run import:sections && npm run import:images && npm run import:menus
scripts.import:menus: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/vs-import/bin/import-menus.php
